answers.core: I would happily use an add-on at this point, but this feels like a boilerplate operation that is important to any serious project where workflow efficiency matters.
answers.workaround: I'm not sure. Since this is a proposal to reduce repetitive work, a script would have to be able to extend the Godot inspector in incremental ways, across all exported properties in all node types. I'm not familiar enough with Godot tool/editor programming to assess this.

title: Add an option to apply individual scene instance overrides to corresponding saved scene
